news.h: Panthers RT Taylor Moton carted off field with fractured fibula
news.d: Panthers right tackle Taylor Moton left Sunday's matchup against the Buccaneers on a cart in the third quarter with a left ankle and fibula injury.

news.h: Taylor Moton among 3 Panthers activated ahead of Eagles game
news.d: The Panthers will have RT Taylor Moton and DE Tershawn Wharton available Sunday against the Eagles. RB Trevor Etienne was also activated off IR.

news.h: Panthers RT Moton coughed up blood before clot diagnosis
news.d: Carolina Panthers right tackle Taylor Moton, 32, told reporters Tuesday that he coughed up blood before being diagnosed with multiple blood clots in June, an ailment that sidelined him through training camp and into the second month of the regular season.
